updateContent.title: EhViewer 2.2.0.20 Compatibility-Safe Update Hardening
content: New builds prefer the deeper runtime metadata path while legacy installs still retain a GitHub compatibility mirror.
Remote hosts and bookmark fallbacks no longer depend on public raw mirror files, reducing public-surface coupling.
Older builds should upgrade to 2.2.0.20 to get the hardened update, recovery, and compatibility path.
